Nissan Sneaks a New Special Edition Pathfinder on the American Market, 2027 SUVs Start at $39,990
22 photos
Photo: Nissan
It’s that time of the year when some of the carmakers playing the game on the American market are busy launching the refreshed versions of their products, dressed in new model-year clothes. Japanese Nissan is no exception, and announced this week the same for the Pathfinder range.
Unlike the competition, though, Nissan has a special reason to refresh this particular model: in 2027, just two months and some change from now, the nameplate celebrates its 40th year of existence. And that deserves a special edition model, which is exactly what Nissan has done.
Enter the 2027 Nissan Pathfinder Special Edition, a visual throwback to the original SUV of the late 1980s, but also a version with dedicated extras. Somehow, the Japanese carmaker managed to sneak the new model smack down in the middle of the lineup.
The so-called 2027 Nissan Pathfinder Special Edition slots between the SL FWD and the Platinum FWD, carrying a sticker that reads $47,390 for the front-wheel-drive, and $49,390 for the four-wheel drive.
For that cash, customers will get the same powertrain that’s available across the range, meaning the 3.5-liter V6 rated at 284 horsepower and 259 lb-ft of torque, tied to a nine-speed automatic transmission.
What makes it special is, first and foremost, the heritage-inspired styling and the unique interior appointments. There’s not that many of them to talk about, but carefully chosen as to mean something for the people with a passion for special editions.
It all starts inside, where Nissan went for a two-tone color scheme in black and burgundy and TailorFit materials designed to reference the cloth seating on the very first Pathfinder from 1987.
In the cabin, there are second-row captain’s chairs, with the rear doors fitted from the factory with sunshades. Finally, a Bose sound system with 12 speakers makes sure the occupants are entertained.
The bodywork of the SUV comes with red accents, and the word Pathfinder is featured on the liftgate. Making the connection with the ground are 20-inch alloy wheels in black, while the rear is adorned with a tow hitch receiver that takes the vehicle’s towing capacity to 6,000 pounds (2,722 kg).
There are, in all, nine Nissan Pathfinder models that can be had in 2027 model year guise. You can find them, prices included (minus $1,575 destination and handling), in the lines below. Before you do that, keep in mind that all of them will become available this November.
2027 Nissan Pathfinder SV FWD - $39,990 2027 Nissan Pathfinder SL FWD - $42,790 2027 Nissan Pathfinder Special Edition FWD - $47,390 2027 Nissan Pathfinder Platinum FWD - $49,890 2027 Nissan Pathfinder SV 4WD - $41,990 2027 Nissan Pathfinder SL 4WD - $44,790 2027 Nissan Pathfinder Rock Creek 4WD - $45,390 2027 Nissan Pathfinder Special Edition 4WD - $49,390 2027 Nissan Pathfinder Platinum 4WD - $51,890
